title: The Quran: Surah 24, an-Nur (The Light)
author: Tradução inglesa de Talal Itani (ClearQuran)
tradition: Texto sagrado do Islão, século VII
intro: Lição sobre a Surata 24. O texto inglês é a tradução de Talal Itani, reproduzida sem alterações; as notas de língua, perguntas, discussão e escrita são material pedagógico separado, baseado apenas no que o próprio texto diz. Cada nível estuda um excerto diferente.

source.title: Quran English Translation: Clear, Pure, Easy to Read Modern English
source.edition: Edition A (uses the word 'Allah' to refer to the Creator)

questions.q: According to verse 36, when is He glorified in these houses?
In verse 37, 'distracts them from' means that trading and commerce do not:
questions.why: 'Distract' é desviar a atenção; o texto diz que nem o comércio os desvia da lembrança, das orações e das esmolas.

questions.q: Verse 37 says neither trading nor commerce distracts these men. What does this suggest?
options: That trade does not take their attention away from remembrance, prayers and alms
questions.why: O texto diz que o comércio não os distrai da lembrança, das orações e das esmolas.

options: Verse 36 gives the place, verse 37 the men, verse 38 the reward
It is a story with names
questions.why: O versículo 36 fala das casas, o 37 dos homens e o 38 da recompensa.

questions.q: Which sentence best sums up verse 38?
options: Those men will be rewarded and increased from His bounty
questions.why: O versículo 38 diz que os recompensará pelo melhor do que fizeram e os aumentará da sua generosidade.

B2.discussion: The passage describes people who keep their attention on what matters even when they are busy with work. What helps people do this in daily life?
B2.writing: Write 80 to 100 words: Say who the men in verse 37 are and what the passage says about them.

questions.q: According to verse 27, what must a person do before entering homes other than his own?
options: Ask permission and greet the occupants
questions.why: O versículo 27 diz: 'until you have asked permission and greeted their occupants'.

questions.q: Verse 28 says 'if it is said to you, “Turn back,” then turn back.' What does this show?
options: That the visitor may enter anyway
That a refusal to let you in must be accepted
That the visitor is a guest of honour
questions.why: O texto manda voltar atrás quando alguém o diz, por isso a recusa deve ser aceite.

questions.q: Verses 27 and 28 give a rule. What does verse 29 add?
questions.why: O versículo 29 diz que não há culpa em entrar em casas desabitadas onde há bens do visitante.

questions.q: Which idea links the three verses?
options: Respect for other people's homes and the conditions for entering them
questions.why: Os três versículos tratam de entrar em casas: o pedido de licença, o respeito pela recusa e uma excepção.

C1.discussion: The passage sets a rule and then an exception. How does that structure make the rule easier to apply?
C1.writing: Write 120 to 150 words: Explain how verse 29 relates to the rule in verses 27 and 28.

questions.q: According to the verse, what is the glass like?
questions.why: O versículo diz: 'The glass is like a brilliant planet'.

options: a comparison worked out through a picture with several parts
questions.why: Depois de 'allegory' o texto constrói uma imagem com várias partes: pilar, lâmpada, vidro, planeta, árvore e óleo.

questions.q: The verse says the oil 'would almost illuminate, even if no fire has touched it'. What does the phrase emphasise?
options: How bright the oil already is, before any fire
questions.why: 'Even if no fire has touched it' sublinha que o óleo quase ilumina antes de qualquer fogo.

questions.q: 'Light upon Light' comes after the description of the lamp, glass, tree and oil. What does it do in the structure of the verse?
options: It gathers the layers of the picture into one short phrase
It begins a list of laws
questions.why: 'Light upon Light' resume as camadas da imagem numa frase curta baseada em repetição.

questions.q: Which description of the verse is best supported?
options: A story with a beginning and an end
A statement, then a picture built in layers, then closing remarks about guidance, parables and knowledge
questions.why: O versículo começa com uma afirmação, constrói a imagem em camadas e termina com frases sobre orientação, parábolas e conhecimento.

C2.discussion: The verse describes light through a chain of images (pillar, lamp, glass, planet, tree, oil). How does adding one image after another shape the way the reader pictures the idea of light?
C2.writing: Write 150 to 200 words: Analyse how the images in this verse are built up, referring to specific words.
